_help: The ONE place a product, its price and its checkout link live.
Edit this file, then run:  node tools/render-store.mjs
That rewrites the Store page cards and every button marked data-product on every page.
price and oldPrice are in CENTS (2500 = $25.00). interval is "month" or "year" for a subscription, or null for a one-off.
payLink is the checkout URL: paste the Squarespace or PayPal pay link for that product.
An empty payLink falls back to an email to support@lavishleaf.org with emailSubject, which is what every button did before.
active:false hides a product from the Store page and turns its buttons elsewhere back into the email fallback.

checkout (top level) is "links" (today: payLink or email) or "cart" (Add to cart and PayPal checkout through the Netlify functions). Leave it on "links" until PayPal's keys are in Netlify and a sandbox order has gone through.
paypalPlanId / paypalSandboxPlanId: the PayPal subscription plan for a product with an interval, in each PayPal environment. tools/paypal-plans.mjs creates them; do not type them by hand.

icon is the emoji shown when a product has no photo. image is an optional photo, given as a path inside this site such as "images/compost.jpg"; put the file there first or the render refuses rather than publishing a broken image. imageAlt describes the photo for screen readers and defaults to the product name.
blurb is an optional sentence shown under the name, up to 200 characters. Leave it out and the card looks exactly as it did before.

waiver is optional: { "version", "url", "label" }. The cart refuses to open PayPal for that product until the box is ticked, in the browser and on the server, and the version travels to PayPal as the order's custom_id. Change the text at url, change the version.
category names the Home shelf a product sits on (shelves appear in the order categories first appear here). tags are extra words the store search matches, beside the name, blurb and category.
ship is true for a product that is posted (it then needs shipOz, its packed weight in whole ounces) and false for a service, registration or pickup-only item. Shipping rates are in shipping.mjs.
